DiPlay is the direct upstream of GalaxyPlay, providing the CarPlay protocol, connection, authentication and media receiver core. GalaxyPlay uses the official release as its baseline and maintains its own interface, configuration and head-unit adaptations for Galaxy L6 and L7. The current core version appears in this dialog title.

The v0.2.11 release of the DiPlay Geely fork by carlito12345 served as an early configuration reference for GalaxyPlay. The specific references were audio focus priority and ducking recovery, factory CarPlay audio usages and microphone input sources, and the hotspot settings entry with a fallback to wireless settings.

GalaxyPlay has since adjusted and maintained its own solutions for Galaxy L6 and L7. Current vehicle templates, interface, media and navigation integration, Bluetooth media exclusion and steering-wheel handling are maintained in this project. This entry preserves the early reference attribution and thanks.
